statements.t: On October 1, 2026, the Company received notice from a tenant that it intends to exercise an option to purchase 13 properties located in Arkansas for an aggregate purchase price of approximately $90.0 million.
The Company expects to fund the acquisition with $14.0 million in cash and $1.0 million in OP Units.

Upon closing, the facility is expected to be added to the Company’s existing Indiana Master Lease 1, resulting in an initial increase in annual base rent of approximately $1.5 million, subject to annual increases of 3%.
